name: 張漢利
objective:
本課程旨在培養學生運用統計推論分析資料變異與不確定性的能力，以支援分析、評估與決策過程。課程重視推論邏輯、假設條件與結果詮釋，強調統計方法在資料分析與系統性問題解決中的應用。課程內容涵蓋統計推論之核心理論與方法，並透過概念說明、課堂討論、小組解題、案例分析與引導式活動，協助學生建立完整的統計思維。

This course aims to develop students’ ability to analyze data variability and uncertainty using statistical inference to support analysis, evaluation, and decision-making. The course emphasizes inferential logic, assumptions, and interpretation. It highlights the role of statistical methods in data analysis and systematic problem solving. Course content covers core theories and methods of statistical inference, delivered through conceptual explanations, discussions, guided problem-solving, case analysis, and structured in-class activities.
schedule:
Week 1: Course orientation and learning approach
Weeks 2–4: Joint probability distributions and correlation
Weeks 5–6: Common joint distributions and functions of random variables
Weeks 7–8: Descriptive statistics and data visualization
Weeks 9–10: Point estimation and sampling distributions
Weeks 11–12: Confidence intervals
Weeks 13–14: Hypothesis testing
Weeks 15–16: Statistical inference for two samples
Week 17-18: Regression analysis (simple and multiple)
scorePolicy:
Quizzes (6 total): 70%
Class Participation and Discussion: 20%
In-Class Assignments / Activities: 10%

Class activities may include short discussions, group problem-solving, case analysis, concept checks, and guided exercises. Participation is evaluated based on engagement and reasoning.
materials: Douglas C. Montgomery and George C. Runger (2018), Applied Statistics and Probability for Engineers, 7th Edition, John Wiley. ISBN 978-1-119-40036-3
consultation: Email and Office Hours. Consultations are available during the instructor’s announced office hours. Prior email appointment is recommended.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
